title: Romantic Pink Heart Crystal Eternity Ring
storyHtml:
A full circle of hearts, because some feelings deserve to go all the way around. A continuous band of heart-cut pink crystal — soft, unbroken sparkle from every angle.

Jewelry that marks your every becoming.
detailsBullets: Heart-cut 5A pink zircon, full eternity setting
